Consent Form

 

This is to confirm that you are 18 years of age or older, you understand the purpose of the project, what is involved and that you are happy to participate.  

 

1. Participation in this survey is entirely voluntary and you can withdraw at any time during the expreiment. 

2. Your details will not be identifiable. As a result, your data will be anonymised, and it will not be possible to withdraw them from the study after completion.

3. All given responses will be analysed and presented as group aggregates, and used for academic research. 

4. Your data will be maintained by Durham University & The Northern Bridge Consortium. All anonymised research data and records needed to validate the research findings will be published in an open access PhD publication and stored by Durham University for 10 years.

5. You confirm that you have understood the information given to you, and the privacy policy for this project. 

6. You opt-in to take part in the study. 

 

You are reminded that you may leave the survey at any given point. You are not forced to take part in this study, if you do not wish to do so.
